Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays against the human single-protein target CHEMBL1255163 (Protein-serine O-palmitoleoyltransferase porcupine). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures as an inner join on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Filter where target chembl_id is CHEMBL1255163, standard_type is IC50, standard_relation is '=', and pchembl_value is not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate rows.
